question.text: When rain is accompanied by a thunderstorm, the collected rain water will have a $\mathrm{pH}$ value:

options.text: Slightly lower than that of rain water without thunderstorm.
Slightly higher than that when the thunderstorm is not there.
Which depends upon the amount of dust in air.

solution.text: Normal rain water has pH 5.6. Thunderstorm results in the formation $\mathrm{NO}$ and $\mathrm{HNO}_{3}$ which lowers the $\mathrm{pH}$
